defs.def: a feeling of pleasure or satisfaction that you get when you or people who are connected with you have done sth well or own sth that other people admire 自豪；骄傲；得意感

ex.s: If your child sees you enjoying your work and taking pride in a job well done, they’re far more likely to do the same.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子看到你享受工作并为把事情做好感到自豪，他们也更有可能这样做。

ex.s: C take pride inD. keep pace with
ex.t: C. 以……为荣 D. 与……并驾齐驱

ex.s: People tend to lake pride in keeping everything in their street fresh and inviting.
ex.t: 人们往往以保持街道上的一切清新、诱人为荣。

ex.s: You can see the joy and pride on the faces of the Chinese fans.
ex.t: 你可以看到中国球迷脸上的喜悦和自豪。

ex.s: With each person I met, I felt a growing sense of pride as part of this extraordinary team, whose devotion to the cause shone from their eyes.
ex.t: 与我所遇见的每一个人,我作为这个非凡团队的一部分,感到越来越自豪,他们对事业的奉献从他们的眼中闪耀出来。

ex.s: The successful flight was greeted with an outpouring of patriotism and pride.
ex.t: 这次成功的试飞受到了澎湃的爱国热情和自豪感的迎接。

ex.s: Finally, traditional festivals are a source of national pride and help shape our national identity.
ex.t: 最后，传统节日是民族自豪感的源泉，有助于塑造我们的民族认同感。

defs.def: a person or thing that gives people a feeling of pleasure or satisfaction 值得自豪的人（或事物）

ex.s: But that’s not the thing he prides himself on.
ex.t: 但这并不是他引以为傲的事。

defs.def: the feeling of respect that you have for yourself 自尊心；自尊；尊严
the feeling that you are better or more important than other people 自负；傲慢
a group of lions 狮群

ex.s: My mother takes pride in her work.
ex.t: 我母亲以她的工作为荣。
